🔥 हर्षवर्धन राणे को लेकर आई है बड़ी और दिलचस्प खबर!
रिपोर्ट्स के मुताबिक एक्टर ने मुंबई में एक नया आलीशान घर खरीदा है।
इस नए लग्‍जरी घर की कीमत पंद्रह से सोलह करोड़ रुपये बताई जा रही है।
यह प्रॉपर्टी Amalfi by Lotus Builders प्रोजेक्ट के तहत है।
एक्टर का यह पहला रियल एस्टेट निवेश नहीं है, बल्कि इससे पहले उन्होंने मद आइलैंड में दो फ्लैट खरीदे थे।
उन दोनों फ्लैट्स की कुल कीमत दस से बारह करोड़ रुपये आंकी गई थी।
हालांकि नए घर के अंदरूनी हिस्सों और सुविधाओं की कोई आधिकारिक जानकारी सामने नहीं आई है।
एक्टर ने इस खरीद पर अभी तक खुद कोई सार्वजनिक बयान नहीं दिया है।
उनकी फिल्म Sanam Teri Kasam के थिएटर्स में दोबारा रिलीज होने के बाद से उन्हें जबरदस्त सफलता मिली है।
प्रोफेशनल फ्रंट पर वह हाल ही में Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat में सोनम बाजवा के साथ नजर आए थे। 🏡✨

ctx.text:
Harshvardhan Rane has reportedly purchased a luxury home worth Rs 15-16 crores at Amalfi by Lotus Builders. The reported acquisition comes at a time when the actor has been receiving renewed attention following the box office success of the re-release of his 2016 romantic drama Sanam Teri Kasam. The actor is also preparing for his upcoming projects, keeping him in the news both professionally and personally.
This is not Harshvardhan's first investment in real estate. The actor had previously purchased two flats in Mumbai's Madh Island, with their combined reported value estimated at around Rs 10-12 crores. His latest property acquisition adds to his existing real estate portfolio, taking his reported investments in these properties to a substantial amount.
While the reported value of the new home has attracted attention, details about the property, including its interiors, layout and other amenities, have not been revealed so far. The actor has also not publicly shared any information about the reported purchase.
Meanwhile, Harshvardhan has witnessed renewed interest in his career over the past year, particularly after Sanam Teri Kasam returned to theatres. Originally released in 2016, the romantic drama found a fresh audience during its re-release and went on to register a strong performance at the box office.
The film's return to the big screen brought Harshvardhan back into the spotlight, with audiences revisiting his portrayal of Inder. Its performance during the re-release also introduced the film to a new generation of viewers, giving the actor's popularity a boost nearly a decade after its original theatrical release.
On the professional front, Harshvardhan was last seen in Ek Deewane Ki Deewaniyat , co-starring Sonam Bajwa. The actor is now looking ahead to his upcoming projects as he continues to receive attention following the renewed success of his earlier film.
With the reported purchase of his new luxury home, Harshvardhan appears to have added another property to his real estate portfolio amid a period of renewed visibility in the film industry.
